universal.C07_CASE_LEVEL_ONLY: C07 v1 emits deterministic case-level evaluation artifacts; aggregate corpus rates belong only to the harness/report.
universal.C07_NO_STATISTICAL_ACCURACY: A case-level protected evaluation is not calibrated accuracy, probability or confidence.
universal.C07_OUTCOME_EVALUATION_DEFERRED: C07 v1 evaluates the frozen recommendation; operational outcome evaluation is not implemented.
universal.C07_STRESS_PROBE_NOT_EFFICACY: C04 stress probes do not establish intervention efficacy or operational benefit.
universal.C07_SYNTHETIC_HGT_ONLY: The protected truth is synthetic scenario evaluation truth and is not production causal truth.

conditional.C07_CAPACITY_ARRIVAL_ONLY_NOT_IDENTIFIAB: C03 v1 does not expose a causal capacity-arrival signal; HGT cannot be used to retroactively grant runtime causal knowledge.
